briefdescription.para: Transient connectivity loss; automatic retry is appropriate.
Target backend is fully unreachable; retry with backoff.

detaileddescription.para: Authentication or authorisation to the transport endpoint failed; operator intervention required.

briefdescription.para: Event payload is malformed or exceeds size limits; must be dead-lettered.

detaileddescription.para: Transport capacity is exhausted (queue full, rate-limited); caller MUST apply back-pressure.

briefdescription.para: Duplicate event detected by the transport; silently discard.
Unclassified internal transport error; always fail-closed.
Canonical transport failure classes for CDC component diagnostics.

detaileddescription.para: All ICDCTransport implementations and transport-dependent CDC components must map their internal error states to one of these classes.

briefdescription.para: Document was updated (before and after available).
Emergency; trigger automatic pause if configured.
Event was added to the open batch.
The batch with the given ID is already committed.
Batch was previously rolled back; cannot commit.
A batch is currently accumulating events.
New schema can read data written with the old schema.
Old schema can read data written with the new schema.
Pause the stream until migration is complete.
Discard events that do not conform to the new schema.
Attempt field-level coercion; drop on failure.
Forward the event to the next stage / subscriber.
Discard the event; do not deliver it.
Explicitly paused by an administrative action.
Paused because a Critical backpressure level was reached.
Paused due to an incompatible schema change.
All events within the replay window have been delivered.
Events may be delivered more than once on failure; consumer must be idempotent or tolerant.
Events are delivered exactly once; requires IIdempotentCDCListener.
Written to outbox; not yet forwarded to Changefeed.
Successfully forwarded to Changefeed and marked done.
Max relay attempts exhausted; record kept for inspection.

detaileddescription.para: Maximum sequence number value. Overflow is not expected in production; if the sequence approaches this value the operator must take a manual snapshot and reset the stream.

briefdescription.para: Sequence value reserved to mean "no sequence / not yet assigned".

detaileddescription.para: Maximum accepted event key size in bytes. Keys exceeding this limit are rejected at recordEvent() time with an appropriate CDCException.

briefdescription.para: Maximum accepted event value payload size in bytes.

detaileddescription.para: Default acknowledgement timeout: an event unacknowledged within this window is eligible for redelivery. Callers MUST NOT assume a longer window without explicit per-request override via DeliveryTrackerConfig or the timeout_override parameter.

briefdescription.para: Maximum allowed per-request ack-timeout override. Values above this are clamped or rejected by the delivery layer.

detaileddescription.para: Maximum in-flight (unacknowledged) events tracked per consumer by default. Once reached, new trackDelivery() calls MUST return false to apply back- pressure; the caller MUST NOT silently drop events.

An event acknowledged after expiry (max_redelivery_attempts exceeded) MUST be reported via ConsumerDeliveryStats::total_expired, NOT silently discarded. This rule ensures diagnostics are always accurate regardless of late ACKs. Maximum events per replay session when no explicit limit is set. Implementations MUST enforce this to avoid unbounded memory consumption.

briefdescription.para: Default replay batch size: number of events returned per nextBatch() call.

detaileddescription.para: Maximum consumer count per group. Groups larger than this value are rejected at createGroup() time with a CDCException.

briefdescription.para: Maximum number of concurrent groups per Changefeed instance.

detaileddescription.para: Lag threshold above which a consumer is considered lagging and diagnostics MUST be emitted. Implementations SHOULD emit a structured warning when the pending count for a consumer exceeds this value.

briefdescription.para: Maximum redelivery attempts before diagnostics escalate to ERROR severity.
Returns true when the transport failure class mandates fail-closed behaviour (dead-letter or halt, no automatic drop or advance).

simplesect.para: true if the event must be dead-lettered or delivery must halt.
